parts.part: Successor publication on an existing PR branch
parts.cause: A linked PR was filtered using the successor pipeline base, which is the PR head branch. Lookup now uses the PR number and validates delivery fields independently. Publication parks admit skip, retry, publish and guarded decision answers.

command: --test-name-pattern=successor PR refusal accepts a guarded decision answer

parts.part: Terminal review after the final budget fix
parts.cause: The default advance fix followed a null pass edge into completion, and retained failed rechecks were automatically fixed and completed. Automatic merge admission also accepted that unreviewed terminal fix.
parts.behavior: One terminal recheck runs on the final fixed head. Pass completes; fail stays in needs_decision across a new controller process. Old completed and queued unreviewed terminal fixes fail merge admission; forge writes revalidate under the mutation lease.

conditions.isolation: Every file runs in a fresh process with private HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR and LLV_STATE_DIR. Viewer and runtime control URLs use a closed loopback port.
conditions.baselineMethod: Restore the changed source modules to the pinned main revision; keep the same test inputs, invocation and isolation. Run a complete main file for every red head file.
conditions.inventory: All tracked test files importing the changed modules, including type imports and engine.fixture consumers; seven additional import or source-boundary checks. Green files require no main sample.
conditions.testSeams: Terminal-budget cases use the real controller and store with deterministic Git/agent ports; restart cases execute a new Bun process. Linked-PR fixtures use real local Git and a simulated forge.
conditions.baselineTypecheck: typecheck-main uses the untouched pinned main tree, including its original test files.
conditions.finalTestRecheck: The two test-only typing corrections were followed by complete runtime rechecks and final static checks; all six source hashes stayed unchanged.

inventoryQuery.resolution: Resolve @/ against src and relative specifiers against the importing file directory; match the six sourceSha256 module paths without their .ts suffix.
inventoryQuery.supplementalAudit: Tracked Bun test naming patterns, explicit .ts/.js suffix normalization, evals, dynamic imports and source-boundary literals.
